exclude: runtime: two screen pages selected through $D018 and their sprite pointers
loader: work page and disk wrapper, copied by the bootstrap at $8A00
runtime: zero-filled work space at entry, reused during play for map and sorted actor data
extra: Packed boot entry $0B decompressed to $0400-$8BFF. The stage overlays later replace $86E9 onward.
Packed boot entry $0C supplies the title and panel glyph page.
